title: Thai beef curry with garden salad

ingredients.name: Beef liver
ingredients.notes: Keep the beef liver cold until cooking and trim ducts, hard white cores, valves or sinew as appropriate. Cut into even 2–3 cm pieces for the gentle simmer. Do not serve offal rare. Check the packet. This name does not confirm a breed or a marble grade.

ingredients.name: Galangal
ingredients.notes: Peeled and finely sliced. Ginger is the usual substitute at the same weight, and it is not the same flavour.

ingredients.name: Lemongrass
ingredients.notes: Tender inner part only, very finely minced.

ingredients.name: Kaffir lime leaves
ingredients.notes: Tear and bruise them. Also sold as makrut lime leaves.

ingredients.name: Vegan red curry paste
ingredients.notes: Choose a paste without fish sauce or shrimp; check allergens and heat.

ingredients.name: Bird's eye chillies
ingredients.notes: Slice. Seeds carry most of the heat. Wash hands after cutting.

ingredients.name: Neutral cooking oil
ingredients.notes: For example, rapeseed or sunflower oil.

ingredients.name: Vegetable stock
ingredients.notes: Prepared liquid stock; use a vegan product and check its label for allergens.

steps.title: Prepare your main
steps.detail: For 4 people, prepare 600 g beef liver. Keep the beef liver cold until cooking and trim ducts, hard white cores, valves or sinew as appropriate. Cut into even 2–3 cm pieces for the gentle simmer. Do not serve offal rare. Wash and prepare the side vegetables; measure the separate portions listed in the steps. Keep raw animal ingredients and their utensils separate from the salad and cooked food.

steps.title: Build the curry-style sauce
steps.detail: Heat 3 tbsp neutral cooking oil in the pan over medium-low heat; do not let it smoke. Add 150 g brown onion, finely sliced or diced. Soften for 4–5 minutes over medium-low heat, stirring, without browning hard. Add 15 g garlic, 20 g lemongrass, 4 bird's eye chillies, finely minced, grated or sliced as appropriate. Stir for 1–2 minutes until fragrant, without burning. Stir in 2 tbsp vegan red curry paste. Fry gently in the existing oil for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly, until aromatic; lower the heat if it catches. Cook the paste before adding the liquid. Pour in 250 ml vegetable stock, 400 ml coconut milk and stir, scraping the base of the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer. Add 15 g galangal, 6 g kaffir lime leaves. Keep the galangal slices intact enough to retrieve. Tear and bruise the makrut lime leaves. Infuse at a gentle simmer for at least 5 minutes, leaving them in during the main's simmer when applicable.

steps.title: Simmer the main
steps.detail: Read the later side-finishing steps now: they need about 2 minutes before service, alongside the main's final cooking/rest. Start longer side actions before this stage if the main cooks more quickly. Add the prepared beef to the sauce. Cover with a lid slightly ajar and keep at a low, gentle simmer, stirring occasionally. Cook for about 107–113 minutes. Add a splash of water if it catches or reduces before the main is cooked; uncover briefly to reduce if the finished sauce is too thin. During the final 10 minutes, prepare the sides in the following steps so they finish close to serving time. The centre must reach 75°C on a clean food thermometer.

steps.title: Near the end: prepare the side ingredients
steps.detail: Prepare sides alongside the main: begin this side during the final 10 minutes of the simmer, allowing the bird's rest where applicable. Wash and dry the produce and use a clean board. Prepare these listed portions once; later steps use the same portions, not additional ingredients. 300 g cos or iceberg lettuce: Wash well, drain and dry; tear any large leaves. 300 g tomatoes: Chopped. 250 g cucumber: Sliced. Read all side steps first: start long-cooking grains or roasting first, and overlap independent pan/steamer work so the components finish together. Keep cold products and undressed salad chilled until the final assembly. Follow this side's own serving instructions.

steps.title: Build the garden salad
steps.detail: Prepare sides alongside the main: Continue these side steps during that same cooking window; do not wait until the main is finished. Tear 300 g washed lettuce into a bowl. Add 300 g chopped tomatoes and 250 g sliced cucumber. Follow this side's own serving instructions.

steps.title: Dress just before serving
steps.detail: Start these side-finishing actions about 2 minutes before serving, overlapping the main's final cooking or rest. For a main that cooks faster than this, begin these actions before starting the main. Toss with 30 ml lemon juice and 2 tbsp olive oil. Season lightly if you like. Do not dress early or the leaves wilt.

steps.title: Finish the regional sauce
steps.detail: Finish when the main has reached its endpoint and the side is ready. After the main has reached its cooking endpoint, lift out and discard the woody pieces of galangal, kaffir lime leaves before the final garnishes; do not eat these whole aromatic pieces. Off the heat, add 30 ml lime juice gradually. Fold through the cooked sauce and taste before adding extra seasoning. Off the heat, fold in 15 g fresh coriander. Wash and finely chop the fresh produce first. Finish and plate immediately so the fresh seasoning stays bright.

steps.title: Bring the meal together
steps.detail: Divide the garden salad and lemon-dressed lettuce, tomato & cucumber between 4 plates. Add the curry-style simmer beef with its sauce. Taste the cooked sauce before adding any extra seasoning. Serve promptly.

title: Thai paneer schnitzel with garden salad

ingredients.name: Paneer
ingredients.notes: Use plain paneer, not a fried or syrup-soaked product. Drain, pat dry and cut into 2 cm cubes. It contains milk.

ingredients.name: Galangal
ingredients.notes: Peeled and finely sliced. Ginger is the usual substitute at the same weight, and it is not the same flavour.

ingredients.name: Lemongrass
ingredients.notes: Tender inner part only, very finely minced.

ingredients.name: Kaffir lime leaves
ingredients.notes: Tear and bruise them. Also sold as makrut lime leaves.

ingredients.notes: Choose a paste without fish sauce or shrimp; check allergens and heat.

ingredients.notes: Prepared liquid stock; use a vegan product and check its label for allergens.
